name: Lynn Kajzer
message: I have been thinking about you a lot with the heat and smokey air. Lots of prayers for your safe travels and no snake encounters! It sounds like a great adventure!! 💕

name: Pablo
message:
"So bye-bye, Miss American Pie  Drove my Chevy to the levee but the levee was dry  And them good old boys were drinking whiskey and rye; Singing, 'This'll be the day that I die  This'll be the day that I die'".  

I think I am out of tune even in writing.
